latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ImageCompress — smart image compression using TinyPNG/Tinify web API.

- Compress PNG, JPEG, and WebP images for free without API key or login
- Supports single image, batch, and directory compression (including optional recursion)
- Automatic retry, request delays, and rate-limit handling built in
- Works with both tinypng.com (global) and tinify.cn (China) servers
- Command-line interface outputting compressed files with detailed stats
- Requires Python 3.6+ and the requests library
